name: Auto Computation - Profile, Avatar & Password Management (Profile Management)

nodes.name: Code - Parse Claims, Avatar Base64 & Action

parameters.query:
WITH auth_check AS (
  SELECT 
    id, 
    (password_hash = crypt('{{ $json.oldPassword }}', password_hash)) AS is_valid
  FROM employees
  WHERE id = '{{ $json.callerId }}'
),
upd AS (
  UPDATE employees
  SET 
    password_hash = crypt('{{ $json.newPassword }}', gen_salt('bf', 8)),
    updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
  WHERE id = '{{ $json.callerId }}'
    AND (SELECT is_valid FROM auth_check) = TRUE
  RETURNING id, email, first_name, last_name, updated_at::TEXT
),
ins_notif AS (
  INSERT INTO notifications (
    id, employee_id, category, title, message, action_route, priority, is_read
  )
  SELECT 
    '{{ $json.notifId }}',
    '{{ $json.callerId }}',
    'COMPANY_ANNOUNCEMENT',
    'Password Changed Successfully',
    'Your account password was updated. If you did not perform this change, contact company operations immediately.',
    '/(tabs)/profile',
    'HIGH',
    FALSE
  FROM upd
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT is_valid FROM auth_check) AS is_old_password_correct,
  row_to_json(upd.*) AS updated_employee
FROM (SELECT 1) dummy
LEFT JOIN upd ON true;

={{ $json.action === 'UPDATE_AVATAR' ? `
WITH upd AS (
  UPDATE employees
  SET 
    avatar_url = '` + $json.escapedAvatar + `',
    updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
  WHERE id = '` + $json.callerId + `'
  RETURNING 
    id, first_name, last_name, email, phone, avatar_url, 
    designation, joining_date::TEXT, employment_type, work_location, role, is_active
),
ins_notif AS (
  INSERT INTO notifications (
    id, employee_id, category, title, message, action_route, priority, is_read
  )
  SELECT 
    '` + $json.notifId + `',
    '` + $json.callerId + `',
    'COMPANY_ANNOUNCEMENT',
    'Profile Photo Updated',
    'Your profile avatar was successfully updated.',
    '/(tabs)/profile',
    'NORMAL',
    FALSE
  FROM upd
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT row_to_json(upd.*) AS employee FROM upd;
` : ($json.action === 'UPDATE_PROFILE' ? `
WITH upd AS (
  UPDATE employees
  SET 
    phone = COALESCE(NULLIF('` + ($json.phone || '') + `', ''), phone),
    avatar_url = COALESCE(NULLIF('` + ($json.escapedAvatar || '') + `', ''), avatar_url),
    updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
  WHERE id = '` + $json.callerId + `'
  RETURNING 
    id, first_name, last_name, email, phone, avatar_url, 
    designation, joining_date::TEXT, employment_type, work_location, role, is_active
)
SELECT row_to_json(upd.*) AS employee FROM upd;
` : `
SELECT row_to_json(e.*) AS employee
FROM (
  SELECT 
    id, first_name, last_name, email, phone, avatar_url, 
    designation, joining_date::TEXT, employment_type, work_location, role, is_active
  FROM employees
  WHERE id = '` + $json.callerId + `'
  LIMIT 1
) e;
`) }}
